g.text: Separate secondary line: V-only FP8 quality → WikiText-2 test, 40 × 2048-token windows; not part of the six-condition BF16 main study.
Design counts, not a claim that every slot is valid. Failed, missing, divergent, or unstable conditions remain explicitly recorded.
AR = autoregressive decoding. EOS = end-of-sequence. KV = key/value cache. Diagram shows the collection method, not an acceleration claim.
